name: adaptive_autovacuum
abstract: Autovacuum that tunes itself: one cluster-global adaptive autovacuum controller for PostgreSQL 17 and 18, installed once per cluster
description: adaptive_autovacuum watches dead-tuple and freeze debt, worker saturation and host capacity, and adjusts PostgreSQL autovacuum settings within guardrails: cluster-wide cost limits and workers, recommended per-table thresholds and temporary boosts with ready-to-run SQL, ANALYZE for tables without statistics, and a guarded emergency vacuum when anti-wraparound autovacuum is demonstrably stuck. Every change is bounded, audited with its previous value and reversible.

adaptive_autovacuum.abstract: Adaptive autovacuum policy controller with background workers
